# cpanel_dns_record (Resource)

Manages one DNS record in a cPanel-managed zone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cpanel_dns_record" "verification" {
  zone = "example.com"
  name = "_terraform"
  type = "TXT"
  ttl  = 300
  data = ["managed-by-terraform"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `data` (List of String) The ordered DNS record data fields. Use `[address]` for `A` and `AAAA`; `[target]` for `CNAME`; `[flag, tag, value]` for `CAA`; `[preference, exchange]` for `MX`; `[priority, weight, port, target]` for `SRV`; and one or more strings for `TXT`.
- `name` (String) The record name relative to the zone. Use `@` for the zone apex.
- `type` (String) The uppercase DNS record type. Supported values are `A`, `AAAA`, `CAA`, `CNAME`, `MX`, `SRV`, and `TXT`.
- `zone` (String) The cPanel-managed DNS zone without a trailing dot.

### Optional

- `ttl` (Number) The DNS record time to live in seconds. Defaults to `14400`.

### Read-Only

- `line_index` (Number) The current zero-based line index of the record in the cPanel DNS zone. It may change when other zone records are edited.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cpanel_dns_record.verification example.com/42
```
